title: New internal primers targeting short fragments of mitochondrial COI for archival specimens
author: Mitrović, Milana
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Initial PCR with Pr2Fd/Pr2Rd
steps.instruction: Perform PCR on archival specimens (samples PD12, PD14, PD15) using the primer pair Pr2Fd and Pr2Rd under the appropriate cycling conditions.

steps.title: Secondary nested PCR (step‑1 products)
steps.instruction: Use the PCR products from the initial reaction as template for secondary nested PCRs.

substeps.instruction: Run a nested PCR with primer pair Pr2Fd and Pr2Rn.
Run a nested PCR with primer pair Aph2Fn and Pr2Rd.

steps.title: PCR with Pr3Fd/HCO2198
steps.instruction: Perform PCR on the same samples using the primer pair Pr3Fd and HCO2198 to generate amplicons.

steps.title: Nested PCR (step‑3 amplicons)
steps.instruction: Use the amplicons obtained in the previous step as template for nested PCRs.

substeps.instruction: Run a nested PCR with primer pair Pr3Fd and Pr3Rn.
Run a nested PCR with primer pair Pr3Fn and HCO2198.

steps.title: Agarose gel visualization
steps.instruction: Run all nested PCR products on an agarose gel to visualize the amplicons as shown in Figure 4.
